basic_details.job_title: NIT Jamshedpur Research Associate III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur, has invited eligible Indian citizens to apply for one Research Associate III post in the DST sponsored project "Sol Cycle", at Rs. 67,000/- per month + HRA @ 20%. The essential qualification is a PhD or equivalent degree, or 3 years or more of research, teaching, design and development experience after ME/M. Tech (ECE/EEE/EE/AEIE/EIE) with at least one published research paper in an SCI journal. Applications go by email to the PI, and the last date of receipt is 23 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed format; the form is printed on page 2 of the notice.
Attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents, a passport photo and the AADHAR card.
Combine the application and all attachments into a single PDF file.
Email the file to the PI, Dr. Surajit Kundu, at [email protected].
Write the email subject as "Application for RA-III under DST sponsored project".
Make sure the application is received by 23 November 2026.
For more information, the notice gives the contact number +919832271039.
Application in the prescribed format, with the passport photo
Self-attested copies of all supporting documents
Proof of age, nationality and category (the form asks to attach proof)
Proof of publications and patents (the form asks to attach proof)
Names, addresses and contact details of two referees (as asked in the form)
The form also asks for educational qualifications from 10th to PhD, thesis title or topic of PhD, work experience, M. Tech/ME dissertation title and a signed declaration.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the position. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason. The assignment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate must work in the Department of ECE, NIT Jamshedpur as a full-time research fellow.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Jamshedpur and the Project
content_sections.text: The notice's opening line calls the post a "temporary position of Project Assistant", while its heading, vacancy line and application form all say Research Associate III.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian citizens are invited. Candidates must ensure their eligibility before applying; the notice says ineligible candidates will not be allowed. Desirable knowledge is listed as Antennas, IoT, Wireless Sensors, computer programming, machine handling and Solar PV Panels. Candidates with relevant experience will be preferred. Age: the upper age limit is 40 years as of the last date of application. Relaxations will be given to female, SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwBD candidates as per the norms of the Govt. of India. The notice does not print the amount of relaxation. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: PhD or equivalent degree, OR 3 years or more of research, teaching, design and development experience after ME/M. Tech (ECE/EEE/EE/AEIE/EIE) with at least one published research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 67,000/- per month + HRA @ 20%. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for one year, which may be extended later or terminated earlier based on performance, evaluated periodically by the PI and Co-PIs. All terms and conditions of the recruitment will be as per the guidelines of the funding agency and NIT Jamshedpur. The selected candidate will work in the Department of ECE, NIT Jamshedpur as a full-time research fellow. Selected candidates can register for the Ph.D. program provided they satisfy the Ph.D. eligibility criteria of NIT Jamshedpur.

Tech/ME dissertation title and a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The tentative date of interview is 25 November 2026. The notice does not mention the interview venue or time, and asks candidates to refer to the Institute website for updates, if any. Original documents of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials must be presented at the interview and at joining (if selected) for verification.
